title: Renewal Loyalty Program Terms: Tenure Share on the Final Electricity Overage Charge
content:
# Final Electricity Tenure Share — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Term.** A final electricity tenure share applies to the final electricity overage line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account:

| Apartment Home Lease move-in date, in whole months before the service end date | Share |
|---|---|
| at least 36 | 0.85 |
| at least 12 but fewer than 36 | 0.92 |
| fewer than 12 | the whole charge (1.0) |

The share multiplies the line's charge, which is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical service end date 2026-03-31):* a move-in date of 2023-03-31 gives 36 whole months and 0.85; 2023-04-01 gives 35 and 0.92; 2025-04-01 gives 11 and the whole charge.

*Worked case (hypothetical charge of $25.50):* 0.85 gives $21.675, which is $21.68 at the end; 0.92 gives $23.46.
